name: nd-launch-anti-hang

  Always-on doorway to CURRENT ND Anti-Hang: hook coverage, effect safety, execution liveness and global-return gating.
metadata:

---
# Anti-Hang — Launcher

ROLE = CROSS_CUTTING_RUNTIME
ROOT_STATEHEAD = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-143
KERNEL = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-397
COMPONENT = ANTI_HANG_RUNTIME / ND-RUNTIME-ANTI-HANG-1
LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-anti-hang/nd-launch-anti-hang
STRUCTURAL_PARENT_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent
MANUAL_ALIAS = @ND Anti-Hang

Resolve only:
`NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry -> ANTI_HANG_RUNTIME -> NAM-397 -> exact canonical artifact`.

Anti-Hang is not a cognitive actor, task owner, scheduler, queue, memory or StateHead. It does not own domain routing, memory lifecycle, provider-route strategy, or message rendering.

## Always-on hook interface

Preferred production call:
`hook(event, **state)`.

Hook events:
`TASK_ENTRY | BEFORE_ACTION | AFTER_ACTION | AFTER_MATERIAL_RETURN | PRESSURE | BEFORE_USER_RETURN | USER_STOP`.

Automation Agent MUST emit the applicable hook at every critical transition and obey the verdict.

The kernel owns only:
- effect identity/replay safety and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN reconciliation;
- pre-action recoverability/composite admission;
- local effect/frontier waiting and no-poll-without-wake;
- root re-entry/cycle rotation after material returns;
- pressure changes execution shape, never global liveness;
- global-return gating and explicit Stop precedence.

Local wait never becomes whole-task wait by itself. No elapsed-time/call/cycle/phase/context threshold creates a routine `Go` gate.

If launcher discovery is temporarily stale, resolve the exact Registry-bound runtime directly; never skip Anti-Hang and never stop a runnable task because of catalog staleness.
